## Research Outcome

## Questions to Answer

## Dependencies and Ordering

Depends on #; blocks #.

## Sources / Interfaces to Investigate

Use dated official sources. Distinguish verified, unavailable and unknown. Do not contact others or apply for accounts without explicit authorization.

## Required Findings

Authentication/access requirements, sandbox, limits, tracking/booking/rates/webhooks, data formats, constraints, recommended adapter and fallback where applicable.

## Constraints / Non-Goals

No secrets, copied PII, unauthorized scraping or invented APIs.

## Deliverable

A committed evidence matrix and recommendation document with source URLs/access dates and unresolved next actions.

## Decision Criteria

Feasibility, supported access, reliability, privacy, cost and fallback.

## Verification

Reviewer can follow sources and reproduce sanitized contract examples; appropriate document/fixture checks pass.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Required questions answered or explicitly unknown with next action/owner.
- [ ] Evidence-backed decision/fallback reviewed; implementation claims are accurate.
- [ ] Repository checks/docs updated with honest limitations.
- [ ] Latest main → dedicated branch → push → linked PR → CI/review → merge → checkout/pull main → cleanup.
